project.name: digitopub
project.description: DigitoPub.com — scientific publishing platform for academic journals: Next.js 16 + React 19 + Prisma 7 (MySQL/MariaDB), read-only OJS 3.x integration, admin dashboard, submission workflow, Stripe payments, AWS S3 storage.

nodes.name: speckit.analyze command
nodes.summary: Spec-kit slash command that performs read-only cross-artifact consistency and quality analysis across spec.md, plan.md, and tasks.md after task generation, with severity-ranked findings and constitution alignment checks.

nodes.name: speckit.checklist command
nodes.summary: Spec-kit slash command that generates domain-scoped quality checklists ('unit tests for English') validating requirements completeness, clarity, and consistency in feature specs.

nodes.name: speckit.clarify command
nodes.summary: Spec-kit slash command that detects underspecified areas in a feature spec and asks up to 5 targeted clarification questions, recording answers in a Clarifications section of the spec.

nodes.name: speckit.constitution command
nodes.summary: Spec-kit slash command that creates or updates the project constitution at .specify/memory/constitution.md, filling template placeholders, bumping semantic version, and propagating amendments to dependent templates.

nodes.name: speckit.implement command
nodes.summary: Spec-kit slash command that executes the implementation plan by processing all tasks in tasks.md phase-by-phase, honoring checklist gates, TDD ordering, and extension hooks.

nodes.name: speckit.plan command
nodes.summary: Spec-kit slash command that runs the implementation planning workflow: fills the plan template, evaluates constitution gates, and generates research.md, data-model.md, contracts/, and quickstart.md.

nodes.name: speckit.specify command
nodes.summary: Spec-kit slash command that creates a feature branch and writes a spec.md from a natural-language feature description, then validates it against a spec quality checklist.

nodes.name: speckit.tasks command
nodes.summary: Spec-kit slash command that generates a dependency-ordered tasks.md from design artifacts, organizing tasks by user story with strict checklist formatting and parallel markers.

nodes.name: speckit.taskstoissues command
nodes.summary: Spec-kit slash command that converts tasks from tasks.md into GitHub issues via the GitHub MCP server, guarded by checks that the git remote matches the target repository.

nodes.name: agent rules
nodes.summary: Governance rule set for the digitopub codebase: strict rules covering OJS-only public identity, SSO token issuance, redirect authority, admin JWT isolation, monetization isolation, and bans on fake data and `as any` casts.

nodes.name: speckit-analyze skill
nodes.summary: Skill-form copy of the speckit.analyze command: read-only cross-artifact consistency analysis across spec.md, plan.md, and tasks.md with severity-ranked findings.

nodes.name: speckit-checklist skill
nodes.summary: Skill-form copy of the speckit.checklist command: generates requirements-quality checklists ('unit tests for English') for feature specs.

nodes.name: speckit-clarify skill
nodes.summary: Skill-form copy of the speckit.clarify command: structured clarification workflow that resolves spec ambiguities via up to 5 targeted questions recorded in the spec.

nodes.name: speckit-constitution skill
nodes.summary: Skill-form copy of the speckit.constitution command: creates or updates governing principles in .specify/memory/constitution.md with version bumps and template sync.

nodes.name: speckit-implement skill
nodes.summary: Skill-form copy of the speckit.implement command: executes all tasks from tasks.md phase-by-phase with checklist gating, TDD ordering, and extension hook support.

nodes.name: speckit-plan skill
nodes.summary: Skill-form copy of the speckit.plan command: generates technical implementation plans from feature specs, producing research.md, data-model.md, contracts/, and quickstart.md.

nodes.name: speckit-specify skill
nodes.summary: Skill-form copy of the speckit.specify command: creates feature specifications from natural-language descriptions with user stories, functional requirements, and quality validation.

nodes.name: speckit-tasks skill
nodes.summary: Skill-form copy of the speckit.tasks command: breaks implementation plans into dependency-ordered, user-story-organized task lists in tasks.md.

nodes.name: speckit-taskstoissues skill
nodes.summary: Skill-form copy of the speckit.taskstoissues command: converts tasks.md entries into GitHub issues via the GitHub MCP server with remote-URL safety checks.

nodes.name: OJS SSO integration spec
nodes.summary: Integration spec for the HMAC-based JIT SSO handover from digitopub to OJS: token structure and 5-minute expiry, provisioning via POST /api/ojs/register/register, sso_login.php consumption, journalPath redirect rules, and anti-caching requirements.

nodes.name: create-new-feature.sh
nodes.summary: Spec-Kit bash script that creates a numbered feature branch (###-short-name) and a specs/<branch>/ directory seeded from the spec template. Supports --json, --short-name, and --number flags, with git and non-git fallbacks.

nodes.name: generate_branch_name
nodes.summary: Derives a 2-4 word kebab-case branch suffix from a feature description by filtering stop words and short words (keeping uppercase acronyms).

nodes.name: check_existing_branches
nodes.summary: Computes the next available feature number by taking the max of the highest numeric prefix across git branches (local and remote) and specs/ directories.

nodes.name: setup-plan.sh
nodes.summary: Spec-Kit bash script that resolves feature paths via common.sh, verifies the current feature branch, creates the feature directory, and copies the plan template into plan.md. Emits paths as JSON or plain text.

nodes.name: update-agent-context.sh
nodes.summary: Spec-Kit bash script that parses a feature plan.md and creates or updates AI-agent context files (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, KIMI.md, etc.) with the current tech stack and recent changes, preserving manual additions.

nodes.name: parse_plan_data
nodes.summary: Extracts Language/Version, Primary Dependencies, Storage, and Project Type fields from a plan.md file into global variables.

nodes.name: create_new_agent_file
nodes.summary: Generates a new agent context file from agent-file-template.md, substituting placeholders for project name, date, tech stack, structure, and commands; adds Cursor frontmatter for .mdc targets.

nodes.name: update_existing_agent_file
nodes.summary: Atomically rewrites an existing agent context file: inserts new tech entries into Active Technologies, prepends the latest change to Recent Changes (keeping only 2 old ones), and refreshes the Last updated date.

nodes.name: update_agent_file
nodes.summary: Dispatches to create_new_agent_file or update_existing_agent_file for a given agent context file path, creating parent directories as needed.

nodes.name: update_all_existing_agents
nodes.summary: Updates every existing agent context file (deduplicated by realpath so aliases like AMP/KIRO/BOB sharing AGENTS.md are written once); creates a default CLAUDE.md when none exist.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Entry point: validates the environment, parses plan data, updates either one specified agent or all existing agent files, and prints a summary.

nodes.name: agent-file-template.md
nodes.summary: Spec-Kit template for AI agent context files (e.g. CLAUDE.md) with placeholders for project name, active technologies, project structure, commands, code style, and recent changes, plus a manual-additions block.

nodes.name: checklist-template.md
nodes.summary: Spec-Kit template for feature checklists generated by /speckit.checklist, with sample CHK-numbered items grouped by category that must be replaced with real checks.

nodes.name: constitution-template.md
nodes.summary: Spec-Kit template for a project constitution defining core principles, additional constraint sections, and governance rules with version/ratification metadata.

nodes.name: plan-template.md
nodes.summary: Spec-Kit implementation-plan template filled by /speckit.plan: summary, technical context, constitution check gate, project-structure options, and complexity-tracking table.

nodes.name: spec-template.md
nodes.summary: Spec-Kit feature-specification template with prioritized, independently testable user stories (P1/P2/P3), edge cases, functional requirements, key entities, and measurable success criteria.

nodes.name: tasks-template.md
nodes.summary: Spec-Kit task-list template organizing implementation tasks by phase (setup, foundational, per-user-story, polish) with [P] parallel markers, story labels, dependencies, and execution strategies.

nodes.name: .env.example
nodes.summary: Example environment file documenting all DigitoPub variables: MySQL app DB, JWT/CRON secrets, audio storage (local dir or S3/R2), OJS read-only DB and PDF bridge, SMTP, and UIET-P1 ORCID identity/tracking settings.

nodes.name: .env.production.template
nodes.summary: Production environment variable template for DigitoPub deployment; content not read because the file matches the sensitive-file guard, but it is referenced as the production counterpart of .env.example.
nodes.languageNotes: File blocked by sensitive-file access guard; summary inferred from file name, CLAUDE.md, and .env.example.

nodes.name: .gitignore
nodes.summary: Git ignore rules covering node_modules, Next.js build output, env files (including .env.example and the production template), generated Prisma client, credential-bearing OJS bridge directories, debug scripts, and Playwright artifacts.

nodes.name: .node-version
nodes.summary: Pins the Node.js version to 20.19.4 for version managers.

nodes.name: .nvmrc
nodes.summary: Pins the Node.js version to 20.19.4 for nvm.

nodes.name: CLAUDE.md
nodes.summary: Primary agent guidance for the repo: DigitoPub architecture (Hono RPC API, feature structure, Prisma/MySQL), the UIET-P1 dual-identity model (admin JWT vs ORCID public identity), hard rules on OJS writes and session usage, commands, conventions, and env var reference.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Project README for DigitoPub: features, quick-start setup with MySQL/Docker, system architecture across digitopub.com and submitmanager.com (OJS), UIET-P1 identity model, SSO registration handoff flow, scripts, and troubleshooting.

nodes.name: components.json
nodes.summary: shadcn/ui configuration (new-york style, RSC, neutral base color, lucide icons) defining path aliases for components, ui, utils, lib, and hooks.

nodes.name: docker-compose.yml
nodes.summary: Docker Compose service definition for a local MySQL 8.0 container (port 3307) that auto-initializes the schema and sample data from scripts/ SQL files via docker-entrypoint-initdb.d.

nodes.name: eslint.config.mjs
nodes.summary: Flat ESLint config combining Next.js core-web-vitals, TypeScript, unused-imports, and react-hooks rules; notably enforces the UIET-P1 no-restricted-imports rule banning admin session helpers and jose.jwtVerify in public routes.

nodes.name: instrumentation.ts
nodes.summary: Next.js instrumentation hook whose register() dynamically imports and fires initializeDatabase() in the Node.js runtime only, so DB initialization runs at server startup without blocking.

nodes.name: register
nodes.summary: Next.js instrumentation register hook; in the nodejs runtime it dynamically imports src/lib/db/init and starts initializeDatabase() fire-and-forget, logging failures.

nodes.name: lighthouse-budget.json
nodes.summary: Lighthouse performance budget enforcing LCP <= 3s, TBT <= 300ms, CLS <= 0.1, and script/total resource size caps for all routes.

nodes.name: middleware.ts

nodes.name: ojs-unavailable.ts
nodes.summary: Shared client-side helper isOjsUnavailable that detects the 503 OJS_UNAVAILABLE error envelope surfaced by parseRpcResponse (spec FR-010).

nodes.name: isOjsUnavailable
nodes.summary: Returns true when an unknown error is an Error whose message is exactly "OJS_UNAVAILABLE", marking an OJS outage response.

nodes.name: use-search.ts
nodes.summary: React Query hook useSearch that queries GET /api/search with q/type params, aborts stale requests, keeps previous results while loading, and never retries failures.

nodes.name: useSearch
nodes.summary: Hook wrapping useQuery<SearchResponse> for /api/search with 30s staleTime, 5min gcTime, placeholderData for flicker-free typing, and retry disabled.

nodes.name: search/index.ts
nodes.summary: Public barrel for the search feature, re-exporting useSearch, useSearchStore, searchQuerySchema and the SearchResult/SearchResponse/SearchQuery types.

nodes.name: search-schema.ts
nodes.summary: Zod searchQuerySchema validating q/type/limit search params plus the SearchableItem, SearchResponse and SearchQuery types shared by client and server.

nodes.name: search/server/route.ts
nodes.summary: Hono router implementing the global GET search endpoint: parallel Prisma queries across journals, articles, authors, categories, solutions and help topics plus static pages, each fault-isolated with a 3s timeout, then deduplicated and ranked by a weighted scoring engine.

nodes.name: searchRouter
nodes.summary: Exported Hono app with GET / that validates the query via searchQuerySchema, fans out per-type searches with safePromise fault isolation, dedupes by id, ranks with scoreResult, and returns results with an optional partial-results warning.

nodes.name: scoreResult
nodes.summary: Weighted ranking engine scoring matches in title (+50 exact/+30 partial), content (+25), description (+15), category (+10), with a +40 boost for journal results.

nodes.name: withTimeout
nodes.summary: Promise wrapper that rejects after a configurable timeout (default 3000ms), used to fault-isolate individual search queries.

nodes.name: search/store.ts
nodes.summary: Zustand store useSearchStore holding the search UI open/closed state with open, close and toggle actions.

nodes.name: use-solutions.ts
nodes.summary: React Query hooks for the solutions feature: useGetSolutions fetches GET /api/solutions, useCreateSolution POSTs a new solution and invalidates the solutions query cache.

nodes.name: useGetSolutions
nodes.summary: useQuery hook that fetches the solutions list from /api/solutions and throws the server error message on failure.

nodes.name: useCreateSolution
nodes.summary: useMutation hook that POSTs a SolutionCreate payload to /api/solutions and invalidates the ["solutions"] query key on success.

nodes.name: solutions/index.ts
nodes.summary: Public barrel for the solutions feature re-exporting schemas, types and the React Query hooks.

nodes.name: solution-schema.ts
nodes.summary: Zod schemas for solution create/update/id-param validation, the SOLUTION_SELECT Prisma select constant, and the inferred SolutionCreate/SolutionUpdate types.

nodes.name: solutions/server/route.ts
nodes.summary: Hono router for the solutions CRUD API: public paginated listing and detail (published-only for non-admins) plus admin-only create, patch and delete guarded by requireAdmin, with BigInt id handling and BigInt-safe serialization.

nodes.name: solutionRouter
nodes.summary: Exported Hono app exposing GET /, GET /:id, POST /, PATCH /:id and DELETE /:id for solutions, using zValidator with solution schemas and paginatedResponse/serializeRecord helpers.

nodes.name: solution-type.ts
nodes.summary: Solution and SolutionResponse interfaces describing the serialized solution entity (string ids/dates) and the API response envelope.

nodes.name: use-get-statistics.ts
nodes.summary: React Query hook useGetPlatformStatistics fetching platform statistics through the typed Hono RPC client with a 5-minute staleTime.

nodes.name: useGetPlatformStatistics
nodes.summary: useQuery hook calling client.statistics.$get() via the RPC client and returning the data payload typed as PlatformStatistics.

nodes.name: statistics/index.ts
nodes.summary: Public barrel for the statistics feature re-exporting useGetPlatformStatistics and the PlatformStatistics schema/type/default constant.

nodes.name: statistics/schema.ts
nodes.summary: Zod platformStatisticsSchema (totalJournals/totalArticles/totalUsers/countriesCount), the inferred PlatformStatistics type, and a zeroed defaultPlatformStatistics constant.

nodes.name: statistics/server/route.ts
nodes.summary: Hono router for GET platform statistics: counts journals from Prisma and articles/users/countries from the read-only OJS database with Promise.allSettled fault tolerance and a 1-hour in-memory cache that only stores fully successful results.

nodes.name: statisticsRouter
nodes.summary: Exported Hono app with GET / returning aggregate platform statistics; returns 503 when OJS is not configured and refuses to cache partial results.

nodes.name: use-count-up.ts
nodes.summary: Client hook useCountUp animating a number from 0 to a target with cubic ease-out once the attached element scrolls into view (IntersectionObserver threshold 0.3), snapping immediately if the target changes mid-animation.

nodes.name: useCountUp
nodes.summary: Hook returning { value, ref }; starts a requestAnimationFrame count-up on first intersection, guards with a ref/state dual flag, and adjusts state during render when the target changes.
